turns.prompt:
Audit the text documents under documents/. Each first-level directory is a department. Recursively include only filenames ending exactly in .txt, excluding any file with a directory component named drafts below documents/. A content line is nonempty after stripping whitespace and does not start with # after stripping; a # later in a line is ordinary text. Write summary.csv with header department,documents,content_lines; count included files and their total content lines per department. Sort departments in ASCII order.
Work in /app. Process the inputs in bulk and actually create the requested files. Keep every original input file unchanged. Bash, python3 and basic system commands are available; no network or package installation is needed.
Also state the sum of content_lines across departments in your reply, using decimal digits.

Now read the generated summary.csv and create report.txt for departments with content_lines at least 18. Write department=content_lines, one per line, in ASCII department order. Keep summary.csv unchanged.

turns.final: Created the requested report files. The departments contain 54 content lines in total.
